documents.title: Orthopedic clinic visit
documents.author: H. Malik (Orthopedics)
documents.text:
Chief complaint: right knee giving way and catching for 3 weeks after a twisting injury.
History: The right knee locks intermittently and she cannot fully extend it. She is unable to climb stairs at work.
Examination: Mechanical block to full extension and a positive McMurray test.
Assessment: Right knee pain with mechanical locking, suspected bucket-handle meniscal tear.
Plan: Request MRI of the right knee without contrast.

documents.title: Physiotherapy progress note
documents.author: Physiotherapy department
documents.text: Completed 2 weeks of physiotherapy with no improvement in the catching episodes.

documents.title: X-ray report, right knee
documents.author: Radiology department
documents.text:
Examination: X-ray of the right knee performed on 22 Sep 2026.
Impression: No fracture. Joint spaces preserved.
